newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude mixed in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude mixed in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil was mixed in late U.S. paper trading on Wednesday, traders said.
Six partial August cargoes switched hands between $17.75 and $17.79 a barrel.
August Brent settled at $17.77 a barrel on London's IPE. September closed at $17.95.
Intermonth spreads were also mixed. July/August Brent traded at minus 18 cents, going out in the range of minus 19 at 15 cents. The range was last pegged at a weaker minus 22/20 cents.
August/September Brent was talked at a steady minus 18/16 cents a barrel, while September/October was valued at minus 15/13 cents, up from minus 14/10 earlier.
